importantTopics: Optimization Basics: Objective, Constraints, Feasible Region
likelyQuestions: What is optimization? Explain decision variables, objective function and constraints with an LPP example.
Explain the steps involved in formulating design problems as mathematical programming problems.
Solve the given product-mix / airline-ticket problem using the graphical method and find the maximum profit.
Solve the given LP problem using the simplex method.
What is an integer programming problem? Discuss the knapsack problem / formulate the given route-selection problem as an IP.
Define the role of constraints in defining the feasible region; discuss the constraint surface in a two-dimensional design space with a diagram.
Formulate the given production-planning problem (e.g., customised vs standard products) as a linear programming problem.
Explain the merits and limitations of the graphical method, and multiple and unbounded solutions in LP.
Discuss the conditions under which the simplex method terminates and how it detects an unbounded solution.
Write a short note on semidefinite programming; give a nonlinear formulation for minimising the sum of Euclidean distances to n points.
